findings: Events search finds the December gingerbread workshop, but its title and calendar link pointed to December 2023. The December Heritage Holiday source pointed to December 2024.

Both 2026 occurrences are confirmed on the organizer's current Programs & Events page. Correct only their source URLs, preserve titles, dates, times, costs, identities and public slugs, and retain the correction through both adapters and cached inputs.
Home and city surfaces retained three activity/meal pairs. Campbell's city plan finished loading; no planner or Home layout change warranted.

Events controls remain ahead of the list, with date, category, area, kids, free and weekend controls. Library coverage is substantial but authoritative; no arbitrary quota/ranking change warranted from volume alone.
Food clearly separates verified openings from final inspections, coming-soon permits and building-permit signals. Camps explicitly labels the completed 2026 season and historical 2026 prices.
Government shows eleven digests, dated agendas and explicit agenda-only language; current Tech surface uses funding, employment and company profiles, without restoring retired sections.
Newsletter archive's latest issue is November 2, appropriate before today's 6 AM send; the issue renders sourced events and activity/meal pairs.

Recent analytics 404 examples are unsuffixed Reading to Children and Chess Club URLs not present in current records or the retired ledger. They do not establish a lost published URL; no invented redirect or page added.
Four source-less newsletter events remain warnings; do not fabricate sameAs URLs. Intentionally unconfirmed listings retain their existing visible warning and omit Event markup.
